derivation: or מְדֻרָה; from H1752 (דּוּר) in the sense of accumulation;

words.word: i will even make the pile

occurrences.text: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
words: I will even make the pile
